scope: P5 predeclared one-task development comparison only; no confirmatory effect estimate

memory.note: Approximate task window from start and duration. Five-second samples; RSS is not GPU allocation and system memory includes other processes.

observations.interpretation: Changes are observed only at turn boundaries. Repeated commands may be necessary after edits; nonzero test exits can be useful observations. These counts do not identify unnecessary work, information loss, or causal task dependencies.

limitations: One previously exposed task and one trial per arm; no quality equivalence or general efficiency claim.
